lead: Accurate prenatal care based on the Date of Last Menstrual Period (LMP).

secoes.corpo:
Add 7 days to the first day of the LMP. Adjust the month:

Jan–Mar:
Add 9 months.

Apr–Dec:
Subtract 3 months.

Count the exact number of days from the LMP to today. Divide by 7. The whole number is the week; the remainder is the number of days.

Gestational Age (GA)

Gestational Age and Estimated Due Date (EDD) Calculator

Accurate prenatal care based on the Date of Last Menstrual Period (LMP).

GI and EDD Calculator

How to Perform the Calculations:
Add 7 days to the first day of the LMP. Adjust the month:

Jan–Mar:
Add 9 months.

Apr–Dec:
Subtract 3 months.

Count the exact number of days from the LMP to today. Divide by 7. The whole number is the week; the remainder is the number of days.
